# v0.9.0b8 — Simpler charging, shared limits

- **One guest-start button:** use the shared kWh limit and target time, stopping
  at whichever active limit is reached first. No separate guest order or draft.
- **Clear HA and app controls:** share energy, time and optional vehicle targets;
  keep intelligent vehicle planning in HA. Refresh the app and five Mushroom examples.
- **Better planning:** adjust to the vehicle’s actual charging power using existing
  meter readings, without extra Modbus polling.
- **Reliability fixes:** preserve guest limits and manual pauses on a proven
  same-plug restart; handle queued starts, cancellations, partial writes and
  competing vehicle plans consistently.
- **Rebuilt guides:** a clear path from installation and first charge to everyday use.

Update the app first: **service 0.9.0b8 or newer, API 2, is required**.
Earlier beta guest orders, drafts and APIs are removed without migration.
Old intent files require acknowledgement of a safe reset. Update dashboard YAML
and affected automations, then recheck permissions, targets and vehicle planning.
